title: Chess, But with 10 SCPs: CONTAINMENT BREACH
summary: SCP containment breach: an 8-wide by 20-deep board under fog of war, with White's army on ranks 1-2, Stockfish's on ranks 19-20, and 10 neutral SCPs from earlier episodes scattered at random positions between them. Each SCP acts after the players by its own episode rule (in a randomised order each game). Seen in action: SCP-966 Sleep Killer zombifies adjacent pieces; SCP-106 Old Man teleports anything in his path to a random empty square (no pocket board here); SCP-409 crystal (ice effect); 'I am a toaster' SCP-426 turns pieces into toasters; SCP-035 mask takes control of pieces; SCP-096 Shy Guy captures anything that looks at it; SCP-049 Plague Doctor; SCP-682 reptile ('Green/Red Lizard'); SCP-173; zombies. Narrator's king gets teleported deep into the fog; SCP-096 eventually captures the black king and he wins game one.
rules: Board: 8 files x 20 ranks; White on ranks 1-2, Black (Stockfish 3600) on ranks 19-20, standard armies.
Fog of war for the player: only squares seen by your pieces are visible; at game end the fog clears and replay controls are available.
10 neutral SCPs placed at random empty squares in the middle ranks; placement and their action order are randomised each game.

After both players move, each SCP acts in turn using its own rule from its solo episode (SCP-966 zombify adjacent; SCP-106 teleports pieces it contacts to a random empty square of the same board; SCP-096 captures pieces that attack/see it; SCP-426 converts attackers/adjacent to toasters; SCP-035 mind-controls; SCP-409 crystallizes radius 1; SCP-173 moves when unobserved; SCP-049 cures/converts; SCP-682 copies attacker movement; plus a zombie SCP).
Kings can be teleported, captured by SCPs, etc.; an SCP capturing a king ends the game (the narrator won when SCP-096 took the black king).
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or outlast it - any capture of the black king (incl. by an SCP) wins.
